summary: The Signalscope is a Hearthian utility-belt tool combining a telescope and a signal receiver. It can detect, identify, and locate audio signals from anywhere in the solar system, making it the player's primary instrument for finding hidden objects, characters, and quantum phenomena.

behavior: The Signalscope's telescope has flexible amplification from no zoom up to 7x.
The Signalscope can detect signals from any place in the solar system regardless of distance.
While the telescope is in use, the player cannot walk or use the jetpack.
Two signals on the same frequency that fall in the same listening cone are superposed and sound like a single combined source.
lore: The Signalscope is part of the Hearthian utility belt that the protagonist carries.
The Signalscope ships out of the box already tuned to the Outer Wilds Ventures frequency.
An unused 'White Hole' sixth frequency exists in the game files but does not respond to anything in normal play.
mechanics: The Signalscope can name a signal source once the player gets close enough to discover what is producing it.
Discovered signals are remembered across time loops, making the Signalscope useful for pinpointing previously found objects of interest.
Using maximum amplification helps localize a signal not just to which planet but to where on the planet it is being broadcast.
Known frequencies are: Outer Wilds Ventures, Quantum Fluctuations, Distress Beacon, Hide and Seek, and Deep Space Radio.
The Hide and Seek frequency only activates after talking to Tephra and starting the hide-and-seek minigame.
Listening to the Outer Wilds Ventures frequency from far outside the solar system superposes all Travelers' instruments into one combined sound.
